explanation.headline: Not on FDA's shortage list; FDA's record shows actions at plants on our labels

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include granisetron hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.
The product label for NDC 69452035001 identifies OrBion Pharmaceuticals Private Limited (FEI 3004540907) as the manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection records show that plant received VAI classifications on 2011-04-07, 2015-06-03, 2019-05-31, and 2023-09-08.
The most recent inspection ended 2023-09-08 with a VAI classification known to FDA on 2023-10-11.
The label's last inspection entry for that plant is NAI dated 2025-10-27.
Corvale East holds 204 tablets of the 1 mg presentation at 7.6 tablets per day (26.8 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 135 tablets at 9.1 per day (14.9 days on hand).
The rule-based best option is to buy from Breckenridge Pharmaceutical, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

rejected.text: Granisetron hydrochloride is not on FDA's shortage list; supply traces to a plant with multiple VAI inspections
rejected.reason: headline: classification VAI is not in the cited evidence

memory.text: Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
